title: Quadratic narrow relation presentation
objective: Compute bounded non-materializing real quadratic narrow class-group invariant factors and ideal maps from authenticated ordinary relation-engine evidence

handoff.summary: Added a bounded ordinary-Python augmented relation presentation for real quadratic narrow class groups. Authenticated principal relations gain an exact norm-sign bit, the orientation generator has order two, saturated negative-norm units collapse it, and exact SNF retains non-split extension data. Public auto/explicit routing now returns non-materializing invariant-factor groups with capped enumeration, bounded arbitrary-ideal inverse maps, exact representative ideals, and replayable live certificates. Added Sage/PARI and Magma fixtures, C4 versus C2xC2 regression coverage, public routing/cap tests, and an opt-in relation benchmark. Full build passed after the final Python source fix; D=12 and D=60 live Buchmann-Hecke computations and certificate replay passed, including D=60 generator ideal roundtrips.
risks: Central integration must raise the number-field-algorithms package budget: this lane measures 1138236 bytes against the current 1120000-byte cap.
The new strict module must be added to pyrightconfig.json by the integration lane because that shared file is outside this lane; direct Pyright reports zero errors.
This is a bounded relation/SNF backend, not NUCOMP. Runtime still depends on the existing Buchmann-Hecke relation collector and inverse ideal reduction may exhaust its explicit candidate cap.
next_steps: Add src/lib/sagejs/number_fields/quadratic_narrow_relations.py to pyrightconfig.json and raise the number-field-algorithms source budget before central architecture checks.
Run exact-head package architecture and changed-test gates after cherry-pick.
